title: introduce-canonical-intake-catalog-and-epoched-diff-synth
author: Riley Chen
description: Motivation: onboarding pipelines currently produce inconsistent manifest shapes (aliasing, optional provenance keys) which makes automated release notes noisy and prevents deterministic sampling for quick release previews. This PR adds a small, focused intake catalog 'wrangler' plus an epoched delta synthesizer to generate compact, readable changelog snippets from model ingest events. Goals: 1) canonicalize incoming intake manifests into a fixed shape and deterministic canonical alias; 2) generate compact 'epoch diffs' between catalog snapshots that are optimized for human-facing release teasers; 3) expose a sampled-delta API used by the console and the model-onboard bot to produce short change bullets without running full diffs over large histories. What changed (high level): - new module catalog/wrangler that normalizes manifests, validates provenance, and computes a manifest_fingerprint for stable identity; - epoched-diff synthesizer that consumes two snapshot epochs and emits a ranked set of deltas with severity/impact hints; - small CLI hook (scripts/changelog/epoch_synth.py) to preview teaser snippets for release authors; - integration with performance-profiles to attach a short profile-summary when a profile delta is detected; - telemetry: histogram for canonicalization failures and a sampled-delta coverage counter. Breaking/compatibility notes: the canonicalizer adds a new top-level field 'canonical_alias' and 'manifest_fingerprint' to persisted manifests. Older consumers that expect arbitrary alias shapes should use the new lookup helper catalog.lookup_by_fingerprint(). Migration: ingestion jobs are updated to write the canonicalized manifest; a migration scaffold for backfilling existing manifests is included but not applied by default. Tests and validation: unit tests for normalization rules, end-to-end smoke test for epoched diffs, and a small performance benchmark to ensure the synthesizer runs within the expected 2s for typical catalog sizes. Rollout plan: merged behind feature flag 'intake_catalog_v2' and staged to dev -> staging -> canary before global enable. Checklist: [x] code compiles and unit tests pass [x] integration tests for synthesizer [x] user-facing docs added [x] telemetry hooked [x] migration plan drafted

review_comments: Maya: Nice separation of concerns here. Two asks: (1) add an explicit canonicalization unit test for the edge case where alias is empty; (2) document the expected fingerprint format in the schema file.
Author (Riley): Added unit test and updated canonical_manifest.py with fingerprint format examples. Left a TODO for implementing a checksum adapter if we later change hashing algo.
Juniper: The ranked delta heuristic looks good but please ensure the perf-profile snippet is size-limited (max 120 chars) so it doesn't bloat changelogs.
Author (Riley): Truncation added and unit test included. Also added a small integration test to ensure snippet attachment is opt-in via config.
Omar: CI flaked on lint the first run; rebase against main fixed it. Consider a follow-up to add a lint rule exception for the generated migration script. Approved after green CI.
release_notes: Introduce canonical intake catalog and epoched diff synthesizer. Adds stable manifest_fingerprint and canonical_alias fields, a sampled delta API for concise changelog/preview generation, and lightweight perf-profile snippets for profile deltas. Opt-in behind feature flag intake_catalog_v2; migration scaffold included.
